slides.label: Verse 1
lines: With our hearts filled with gratitude
And hands lifted up in praise
I thank You, Lord
You chose me to bless me the way only You can

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: The rewarder of my faith
The I AM in whom I am
Your unwavering, preserving grace
Will never let me fall
For You delight in me
Gracious Father

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Thank You, Lord, for answered prayers
For every prophecy fulfilled
Faithful God, You are
You gave me a seat at Your throne, Lord
To rule and reign with You
King of glory

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Your love amazes me
Over and over again, Dear Lord

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Anything is possible with You Lord
You lift up the humble, and cast down the wicked
Your Word mends broken hearts

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: For Your mercy prevails over the judgement of men
You are more than my words could ever say
You are more than enough could ever be
Wonderful Father
